   136	def load_embeddings(path: Path) -> np.ndarray:
   137	    """Load an (N, D) item-embedding matrix.
   138	
   139	    Accepts either:
   140	    - a Parquet frame with an ``embedding`` column of per-row arrays
   141	      (the historical RecBole3.0 ``item_emb.parquet`` convention), or
   142	    - an ``*.npy`` file containing an ``(N, D)`` ``float32`` array
   143	      (stage1's ``sentence_t5.npy`` output).
   144	    """
   145	    suffix = path.suffix.lower()
   146	    if suffix == ".npy":
   147	        embeddings = np.asarray(np.load(path), dtype="float32")
   148	    elif suffix in {".parquet", ".pq"}:
   149	        frame = pd.read_parquet(path)
   150	        if "embedding" not in frame:
   151	            raise ValueError(f"Embedding file must contain an embedding column: {path}")
   152	        embeddings = np.stack(frame["embedding"].to_numpy()).astype("float32", copy=False)
   153	    else:
   154	        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported embedding file suffix: {path}")
   155	    if embeddings.ndim != 2 or not np.isfinite(embeddings).all():
   156	        raise ValueError(f"Invalid embedding matrix: shape={embeddings.shape}")
   157	    return embeddings

   160	def maybe_apply_pca(embeddings: np.ndarray, pca_dim: int, seed: int) -> np.ndarray:

   164	        raise ValueError(f"--pca_dim must be smaller than input dimension {embeddings.shape[1]}")
   165	    from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
   166	
   167	    reduced = PCA(n_components=pca_dim, whiten=True, random_state=seed).fit_transform(embeddings)
   168	    return reduced.astype("float32", copy=False)

   179	def _extend_collisions(tokens: np.ndarray, codebook_sizes: list[int]) -> np.ndarray:
   180	    """Match RecBole3.0's extend path with one fixed extra SID level."""
   181	    if tokens.ndim != 2 or tokens.shape[1] != len(codebook_sizes):
   182	        raise ValueError(f"Token shape {tokens.shape} disagrees with codebook sizes {codebook_sizes}")
   183	    groups: dict[tuple[int, ...], list[int]] = {}
   184	    for item_id, row in enumerate(tokens.tolist()):
   185	        groups.setdefault(tuple(int(value) for value in row), []).append(item_id)
   186	    offsets = np.cumsum([0, *codebook_sizes], dtype=np.int64)
   187	    result = np.empty((len(tokens), tokens.shape[1] + 1), dtype=np.int64)
   188	    for row, item_ids in groups.items():
   189	        for occurrence, item_id in enumerate(item_ids):
   190	            result[item_id, :-1] = np.asarray(row, dtype=np.int64)
   191	            result[item_id, -1] = int(offsets[-1] + occurrence)
   192	    return result

   439	def _launch_via_torchrun() -> None:

   442	        return  # 已经在 torchrun 启动的子进程里

   449	    env["NCCL_TIMEOUT"]        = "3600"

   455	        f"--master_port={_LAUNCHER['master_port']}",
   456	        _LAUNCHER["script"],

   458	    with open(_LAUNCHER["log"], "w", encoding="utf-8") as fout:
   459	        rc = subprocess.call(cmd, stdout=fout, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env)

   465	    main()

   136	def load_embeddings(path: Path) -> np.ndarray:

   179	def _extend_collisions(tokens: np.ndarray, codebook_sizes: list[int]) -> np.ndarray:
   180	    """Match RecBole3.0's extend path with one fixed extra SID level."""
   181	    if tokens.ndim != 2 or tokens.shape[1] != len(codebook_sizes):

   183	    groups: dict[tuple[int, ...], list[int]] = {}

   185	        groups.setdefault(tuple(int(value) for value in row), []).append(item_id)

   291	    if rank == 0:
   292	        print(f"[RecBole RQ-VAE] device={device} all_items={len(all_embeddings)} train_items={len(train_embeddings)} world_size={world_size}", flush=True)
   293	        print(f"[RecBole RQ-VAE] config: epochs={EPOCHS} batch_size_per_rank={BATCH_SIZE_PER_RANK} total_batch={BATCH_SIZE_PER_RANK*world_size} lr={LR}", flush=True)
   294	        _record(rank, "train_start", epochs=EPOCHS, batch_size_per_rank=BATCH_SIZE_PER_RANK, total_batch_size=BATCH_SIZE_PER_RANK*world_size, lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY, hidden_sizes=list(HIDDEN_SIZES), codebook_num=CODEBOOK_NUM, codebook_size=list(CODEBOOK_SIZE), codebook_dim=CODEBOOK_DIM, beta=BETA, vq_type=VQ_TYPE, ema_decay=EMA_DECAY, sk_epsilon=SK_EPSILON, sk_iters=SK_ITERS, pca_dim=PCA_DIM, xavier_init=XAVIER_INIT, warmup_epochs=WARMUP_EPOCHS, gradient_clip_norm=GRADIENT_CLIP_NORM, optimizer=OPTIMIZER, seed=SEED, num_workers=NUM_WORKERS, eval_interval=EVAL_INTERVAL, early_stop="disabled", all_items=len(all_embeddings), train_items=len(train_embeddings), embedding_shape=list(embeddings.shape), world_size=world_size)
   295	
   296	    # === codebook init: only rank 0 (codebook 不是 DDP 参数, 全 rank 共享) ===
   297	    if rank == 0:
   298	        print("[RecBole RQ-VAE] initializing codebooks with KMeans", flush=True)
   299	    raw_module = model.module if isinstance(model, DDP) else model
   300	    with torch.no_grad():
   301	        raw_module.init_codebook(train_embeddings.to(device))
   302	    if world_size > 1:
   303	        dist.barrier()
   304	
   305	    # Stage3 only consumes the final-epoch weights, so tracking the best
   306	    # collision across epochs would be misleading; keep the last evaluation.
   307	    final_collision = float("inf")
   308	    final_raw_unique = 0
   309	    codebook_sizes = list(config.codebook_size)
   310	
   311	    for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS + 1):
   312	        if train_sampler is not None:
   313	            train_sampler.set_epoch(epoch - 1)
   314	        model.train()
   315	        losses: list[float] = []
   316	        recons: list[float] = []
   317	        _epoch_t0 = time.time()
   318	        for batch, contexts in loader:
   319	            batch = batch.to(device, non_blocking=True)
   320	            contexts = contexts.to(device, non_blocking=True)
   321	            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
   322	            reconstructed, quant_loss, _, _ = model(batch, contexts)
   323	            # === DDP 包装下, 通过 .module 调 compute_loss (避免 DDP all_reduce 干扰) ===
   324	            loss, recon_loss = raw_module.compute_loss(batch, reconstructed, quant_loss)
   325	            if not torch.isfinite(loss):
   326	                raise RuntimeError(f"RQ-VAE loss became non-finite at epoch {epoch}")
   327	            loss.backward()
   328	            if GRADIENT_CLIP_NORM > 0:
   329	                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRADIENT_CLIP_NORM)
   330	            optimizer.step()
   331	            scheduler.step()
   332	            losses.append(float(loss.detach()))
   333	            recons.append(float(recon_loss.detach()))
   334	        epoch_time_s = round(time.time() - _epoch_t0, 3)
   335	
   336	        # === DDP all_reduce: 跨 rank 求平均 loss / recon ===
   337	        local_loss = torch.tensor(float(np.mean(losses)) if losses else 0.0, device=device)
   338	        local_recon = torch.tensor(float(np.mean(recons)) if recons else 0.0, device=device)
   339	        if world_size > 1:
   340	            dist.all_reduce(local_loss, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
   341	            dist.all_reduce(local_recon, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
   342	        avg_loss = float(local_loss.item()) / max(world_size, 1)
   343	        avg_recon = float(local_recon.item()) / max(world_size, 1)
   344	        cur_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
   345	
   346	        # === 非 eval 间隔: 只 log train 行 ===
   347	        if epoch % EVAL_INTERVAL != 0 and epoch != EPOCHS:
   348	            if rank == 0:
   349	                print(f"[RQ-VAE] epoch={epoch} loss={avg_loss:.8f} recon={avg_recon:.8f} lr={cur_lr:.3e} time={epoch_time_s}s", flush=True)
   350	                _record(rank, "train", epoch=epoch, loss=avg_loss, recon=avg_recon, lr=cur_lr, epoch_time_s=epoch_time_s, cumulative_time_s=round(time.time() - _T0, 3))
   351	            continue
   352	
   353	        # === eval 间隔: only rank 0 跑 (避免 4 卡 N× 全集评估) ===
